headline: Waymo's driverless taxis now serve Nashville International Airport.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: a driverless-taxi expansion to a major airport, confirmed by several outlets, with few details available.
importance_line: Travellers in Nashville can now ride a driverless taxi to and from the airport, but the start date, fares and ride volumes are not reported here.
summary: The Business Journals reports that Waymo, Alphabet's driverless taxi service, has expanded service to Nashville International Airport (BNA), and WKRN News 2 describes it as the first fully autonomous ride-hailing service to offer airport transportation in Tennessee.
notes: The Business Journals page (HTTP 403) could not be opened, and WKRN, TravelPulse and Airline Routes & Ground Services were also blocked; only a one-sentence WKRN blurb on Yahoo was readable, so the entry is cautious. Several outlets carry the same headline fact, so the score is not lowered.
